pages.title: Admin Commands
pages.text: All commands require permission level 2.$(br2)$(bold)/animalflee blacklist add|remove$() — hold a spawn egg to add/remove a mob from the flee blacklist.$(br2)$(bold)/animalflee customfood add [value]|remove$() — hold an item to add/remove custom animal food.

pages.title: Diet Commands
pages.text: $(bold)/animalflee diet$() — show the diet of the entity in your hand.$(br2)$(bold)/animalflee diet add herbivore|carnivore|omnivore$() — set the diet.$(br2)$(bold)/animalflee diet remove herbivore|carnivore$() — remove from a diet list (becomes omnivore).

pages.title: Configuration
pages.text: Open the config screen from the Mods menu, or edit $(bold)animalflee-server.toml$() in the config folder.$(br2)Key options: flee trigger distance, hunger drain rate, pregnancy duration, egg incubation time, herbivore/carnivore lists, and more. All options support hot reload!
